required_events.event: Morning light pours over the kitchen counter as Amy flips a pancake, humming softly while Will and Amber scramble around her feet with sticky fingers.
A slam of wood against the front door shatters the quiet; a zombie lurches inside, its eyes glazed on the family below.
Amy pulls Will toward the back bedroom, then pushes Amber into the pantry behind the fridge—her safe spot—and locks the door with a quick twist of her key.
She darts back to the kitchen, heart hammering against her ribs like a drumbeat.
Under the floorboard beside the stove she uncovers a pistol and a katana, both gleaming in the thin light that spills from the window.
The zombie shuffles forward; Amy fires the pistol, then slashes with the katana—one body falls to splintered wood.
More zombies spill through cracks in the walls, each one lunging at her; she ducks and shoots, cutting them down one by one until only a single husk remains.
With the last zombie crumpled beside the stove, Amy rushes back to the pantry door, pulls Will out first, then scoops Amber into her arms—both kids breathing in relief as they step outside together.

# Phase 1
1. Morning light pours over the kitchen counter as Amy flips a pancake, humming softly while Will and Amber scramble around her feet with sticky fingers.
2. A slam of wood against the front door shatters the quiet; a zombie lurches inside, its eyes glazed on the family below.
3. Amy pulls Will toward the back bedroom, then pushes Amber into the pantry behind the fridge—her safe spot—and locks the door with a quick twist of her key.
4. She rushes back toward the stove, heart hammering against her ribs like a drumbeat.
5. Under the floorboard beside the stove she uncovers a pistol and a katana, both gleaming in the thin light that spills from the window.
6. The zombie shuffles forward; Amy fires the pistol, then slashes with the katana—one body falls to splintered wood.
7. Suddenly, several fresh zombies burst through the kitchen cracks, lunging at her; Amy ducks, fires her pistol, then slashes with the katana, dispatching each one until only a lone husk lingers.
8. With the last zombie crumpled beside the stove, Amy rushes back to the pantry door, pulls Will out first, then scoops Amber into her arms—both kids breathing in relief as they step outside together.
